## Algorithm

* [Decay-chain enumeration by stitching](decay-chains.md) - Core and decays are enumerated separately and glued at forced lines; MadGraph's decay assignment; permutations of identical particles between blocks; container equality as the oracle.
* [Diagram enumeration through feyngraph](diagram-enumeration.md) - Topology-then-assignment generation via feyngraph and what vibegraph adds (aliases, s-channel filters, own model); comparison with MadGraph's leg combination, DiagramTag and NGRAPHS counting.

## Design

* [1 → n decay processes and partial widths](decay-processes.md) - A decay is a one-initial process at rest with flux 1/2M, integrated to a partial width; MadEvent's decay-run card defaults and event layout.
* [Subprocess enumeration: initial-state orderings and outgoing dedup](subprocess-enumeration.md) - The enumerator emits one ordering per unordered initial state (the mirror term supplies the other) and deduplicates on (sorted initial, sorted final), matching MadGraph's subprocess set.

## Design Decision

* [Keep every pairing of identical particles across decays](identical-particles-across-decays.md) - Unlike MadGraph's single pairing with identical_decay_chain_factor, all pairings and their interference are kept; expected σ offset about +0.2%.
* [Parse everything, check once, narrow the type](supported-card-check.md) - ProcCardAst mirrors ProcessDefinition; check_supported reports every unsupported feature and returns a narrower SupportedCard; squared-order constraints are a hard refusal, never dropped.

## Physics Convention

* [Polarized external particles](polarization.md) - MadGraph's polarization syntax and codes, NHEL lists, IDEN averaging, identical-particle keying and me_frame; polarized |M|² is frame dependent.
* [Proc-card grammar and command semantics (MadGraph parity)](proc-card-grammar.md) - How MadGraph reads a process line and proc card: modifier strip order and regexes, leg classification, coupling-order operators, @N, generate/add process, duplicates, the p/j rewrite.
* [Required, forbidden and on-shell-vetoed s-channels (>, $$, $)](s-channel-restrictions.md) - > and $$ are diagram filters inside the WEIGHTED search with MadGraph's line orientation; $ zeroes marked core lines inside the bwcutoff window pointwise in the amplitude, keeping interference.
